summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-printing feature per the spec. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base style "json.", combined pattern for brace, literals, number, str); rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* theme entries; new rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable (parse, dumps with indent, highlight, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, __rich__ returns stored Text) and a __main__ CLI with soft_wrap printing and an OSError read-failure path that exits -1; rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print with a lazy JSON import; rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json delegating to the global console; docs get a "Printing JSON" section in console.rst, reference/json.rst, a toctree entry, and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; tests added: test_print_json in tests/test_console.py and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. The exact ANSI codes in test_print_json were derived by reading Rich's style code and are unverified until tests are run. Choices: overflow set to Python None; CLI catches OSError only; number pattern has no trailing \b.
